_comment: Frix TeamSpeak 3 bot — Pterodactyl egg. Panel → Admin → Nests → Import Egg
name: Frix TeamSpeak 3 Bot
author: lyusufdeniz@users.noreply.github.com
description: Frix: TeamSpeak 3 music and server bot with a web panel (YouTube, radios, own music library, plugins, scripts). The web panel runs on the server's primary port.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Frix kurulumu: GitHub'daki sürümü indirir, kullanıcı verilerine dokunmaz
set -e
apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq curl unzip ca-certificates jq >/dev/null
cd /mnt/server
ARCH=$(uname -m)
if [ "$ARCH" = "aarch64" ]; then ASSET=Frix-linux-arm64.zip; else ASSET=Frix-linux-x64.zip; fi
if [ -z "${FRIX_RELEASE}" ] || [ "${FRIX_RELEASE}" = "latest" ]; then
  URL="https://github.com/lyusufdeniz/frix-teamspeak-3-bot/releases/latest/download/$ASSET"
else
  URL="https://github.com/lyusufdeniz/frix-teamspeak-3-bot/releases/download/${FRIX_RELEASE}/$ASSET"
fi
echo "Indiriliyor: $URL"
curl -fsSL -o /tmp/frix.zip "$URL"
rm -rf /tmp/frix && mkdir -p /tmp/frix && unzip -qo /tmp/frix.zip -d /tmp/frix
SRC=$(find /tmp/frix -maxdepth 2 -name TS3AudioBot -type f -printf '%h' -quit)
cd "$SRC"
find . -type f | while IFS= read -r f; do
  case "$f" in
    ./ts3audiobot.toml|./rights.toml|./ytdlp/yt-dlp.conf) [ -e "/mnt/server/$f" ] && continue ;;
  esac
  mkdir -p "/mnt/server/$(dirname "$f")"
  cp -f "$f" "/mnt/server/$f"
done
chmod +x /mnt/server/TS3AudioBot /mnt/server/frix.sh /mnt/server/ytdlp/yt-dlp /mnt/server/ytdlp/deno 2>/dev/null || true
echo "Frix kuruldu. Panel: sunucunun ana portunda (ilk acilista yonetici hesabini olustur)."

variables.name: Frix release
variables.description: Version tag to install (for example v2.16.0) or latest. Reinstall the server to update; your data is kept. You can also update from the web panel.
